result.title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
result.summary: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing and enables stronger zero-shot action transfer across visual contexts and embodiments. Beyond generative video priors, we further extend our framework to predictive representation priors such as V-JEPA2, achieving competitive performance. Our findings suggest a broader paradigm for latent-action learning: repurposing pretrained video models to discover transferable actions and predict their consequences.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 O²LaF：用同一个预训练视频 DiT 分别初始化逆动态编码器（可学习 action query 的前馈转移编码器）与因果、动作条件的前向视频生成器，经紧凑瓶颈端到端联合优化，从无标注视频学到可迁移的 latent action，并验证可换用 V-JEPA2 等预测表示先验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「控制信息访问的紧凑瓶颈＋前向/逆动态联合训练＋预测表示先验」可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何避免信息坍缩、如何分配训练贡献；但研究对象是视频动作学习与具身迁移，与 VLM 推理无直接关联，线索需人工判断。
